products.name: Magnesium Bis Glycinate
products.description: Our fully reacted Magnesium Bisglycinate chelated —is a premium, high-quality form of magnesium designed for maximum results. our magnesium is naturally bonded with amino acids. This makes it incredibly easy for your body to absorb and 100% gentle on your stomach. It has a Superior Bioavailability. magnesium glycinate is a premium organo-mineral compound widely considered the gold standard for magnesium supplementation. It consists of one elemental magnesium ion chemically bound (chelated) to two molecules of glycine, the simplest amino acid.

features.title: Exceptional Gastrointestinal Tolerance
features.text: Unlike inorganic salts, stable magnesium bisglycinate bypasses standard ion channels and avoids mineral competition by utilizing intestinal peptide pathways (PEPT1) for absorption. This unique metabolic route ensures significantly higher cellular uptake without relying on stomach acid breakdown.

features.text: As a stable, fully reacted heterocyclic ring, this true chelate prevents magnesium from binding with dietary phytates, oxalates, or tannins, protecting the mineral from being blocked or wasted in the digestive tract.

features.title: Excellent Formulation Stability
features.text: True chelates are chemically neutral and highly stable. Because they do not easily react with other ingredients (like vitamins C or B), they prevent degradation, off-flavors, and color changes—significantly extending your product's shelf-life.
